statement: The generic arithmetic splitting-field Galois group of the twelve rational cubics through eight Q-rational points is S12. Outside a thin exceptional set of rational configurations, the specialized Galois group is also S12.

answer.text: The generic arithmetic splitting-field Galois group of the twelve rational cubics through eight Q-rational points is S12. Outside a thin exceptional set of rational configurations, the specialized Galois group is also S12.
answer.display: S12 for the generic arithmetic problem over Q; complex geometric monodromy not extracted here.

group.description: S12 in its natural action on the twelve rational cubic curves; this record concerns arithmetic Galois action over Q

source.location: §3, “Splitting fields for e=3”, printed pp.299–300; paragraph after Proposition 2.2 on p.296

notes:
The arithmetic generic group is not by itself a proof of the geometric complex monodromy group. The printed eight-point witness list on p.299 repeats (−3,1); the paper also gives the pencil cubics and discriminant polynomial. The MAGMA calculation was read, not independently rerun. Do not silently repair the witness coordinates.

Standard generating permutations, when newly supplied here, are an abstract relabeling of the proved group action; they are not additional path-tracking data. Linking the arithmetic group does not upgrade this record to a proof of complex geometric monodromy.

Section 3 proves this using an explicit degree-12 discriminant polynomial and an exact MAGMA group computation.
scope: Twelve irreducible rational cubics through eight general labelled points. The extracted Galois statement is arithmetic over Q and the rational function field of the point-configuration space, and for Q-rational specializations outside a thin set.
